files.role: Python project manifest. Dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, pydantic, pyyaml. Dev dependencies: pytest, httpx. Mirror StorageTracker's pyproject.toml structure.

Container image. Build context is repo root. Copies 02_Platform/packages to /platform_packages, sets PYTHONPATH. Copies backend/, schema.sql, tests/. CMD: uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000. Identical structure to StorageTracker/Dockerfile.

Docker Compose service definition. container_name atlas-storyreader. Port 127.0.0.1:8026:8000 (least exposure — no other Atlas host port uses 8026 as of this design; 8022-8025 are taken by StorageTracker/Calendar/EssayCards/ClaudeConsole). Environment: ATLAS_PG_* vars, ATLAS_PG_HOST=atlas-postgres. Volumes: ${STORYREADER_CONTENT_DIR}:/app/content:ro, ${DATA_ROOT}/storyreader/logs:/app/logs. Joins atlas-net.

Connection pool management. Identical pattern to StorageTracker/EssayCards: _build_url() from ATLAS_PG_* or DATABASE_URL, SimpleConnectionPool(minconn=1, maxconn=5, RealDictCursor), get_db() context manager, init_schema() reads schema.sql relative to module path.

methods.name: init_schema
methods.purpose: Execute schema.sql idempotently against the pool on startup.

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Borrow a pooled connection, roll back on exception, always return it to the pool.

files.role: The single canonical paragraph-split/render function, shared verbatim by ingestion and the version-content read endpoint. Pure function, no I/O, no DB access.

methods.name: split_paragraphs
methods.purpose: Render body_markdown into an ordered list of plain-text paragraph strings per the exact algorithm in 10_architecture.json contracts.invariants (blank-line block splitting; heading/blockquote/list/fence-marker stripping; inline emphasis/link stripping; one paragraph per block, lines joined with a single space).

files.role: Ingestion core (importable) plus `python -m backend.ingest <path>` CLI entrypoint. The only way story content enters the app.

methods.name: upsert_story
methods.purpose: Read the file at file_path (relative to /app), split front matter/body, validate front-matter slug == filename-derived slug and required keys present, compute content_sha256, upsert storyreader.stories/story_versions per 10_architecture.json internal_flow step 2, all inside one transaction. Raises IngestionError on any validation failure — never partially writes.

methods.name: main
methods.purpose: Parse the CLI argument, open a DB connection, call upsert_story, print the one-line JSON summary to stdout on success or the error message to stderr on IngestionError, return 0 or 1 accordingly. Invoked via `if __name__ == '__main__': sys.exit(main(sys.argv))`.

methods.name: _parse_front_matter
methods.purpose: Split the leading --- YAML block from the markdown body using PyYAML; raise IngestionError on unparsable YAML.

files.role: All story, version, and annotation endpoints. Single router file, mirroring StorageTracker's backend/routers/items.py single-file convention.

methods.name: get_version_content
methods.purpose: GET /stories/{story_id}/versions/{version} — internal_flow step 5. version path segment is 'latest' or an integer string. Response row includes the resolved version's own story_versions.id as the row's required id field (R-CON-BP-04).

methods.name: create_or_update_annotation
methods.purpose: POST /annotations — internal_flow step 7. Returns 201 on insert, 200 on in-place reaction update.

methods.name: export_annotations
methods.purpose: GET .../annotations/export — internal_flow step 9. R-CON-BP-04 exempt on success.

methods.name: _resolve_version
methods.purpose: Shared by get_version_content (allow_latest=True) and list_annotations/export_annotations (allow_latest=False). Raises the appropriate ApiError (VALIDATION_ERROR or NOT_FOUND) per contracts.failure_modes.

files.role: Canonical schema DDL — copy of Sprint01_Core/10_schema.sql promoted to component root. Idempotent (create table/schema if not exists). Executed at startup by backend/database.py::init_schema().

FastAPI app entry point. Installs CORS (allow_origin_regex localhost), exception handlers, request timing. Includes stories router at prefix /api/storyreader. On startup: init_pool(), init_schema(). Identical structure to StorageTracker's backend/main.py, with allow_methods=[GET, POST, DELETE] (no PATCH/PUT in this API).
React entry point registered with Atlas Shell. Routing and all UI views.

Shell registration config. appId 'storyreader', basePath '/storyreader'. mobilePrimaryNav is the primary target (one-handed phone reading); desktopNav mirrors it for consistency, per StorageTracker's shellConfig.ts pattern.

App-local guidance for Claude Code. Restates the Codex Integration section from 00_draft.md (ingestion command, export curl command, story_id/slug resolution rule) as the authoritative reference for both the human and Codex, EssayCards-style. States the port (8026) and schema (storyreader).

nginx_note: Not a file in this component — the implementer must additionally add a `location /api/storyreader { set $upstream_storyreader atlas-storyreader:8000; ... }` block to 02_Platform/Atlas_Shell/nginx.conf, matching the existing per-app block shape (see the /api/essaycards block for the exact pattern). Listed here rather than as a scaffolded file because it lives outside 03_Application/StoryReader.
main_tsx_note: Not a file in this component — the implementer must additionally add a side-effect import for src/shellConfig.ts to 02_Platform/Atlas_Shell/src/shell/main.tsx's REGISTER APPLICATION SHELLS block: `import '../../../../03_Application/StoryReader/src/shellConfig';`, matching the existing per-app import shape (see e.g. StorageTracker's import in main.tsx for the exact mobilePrimaryNav-app pattern). Without this import, AppRegistry.register() for storyreader never executes and the app is unreachable through the shell despite a healthy backend and a correctly built frontend bundle. Listed here rather than as a scaffolded file because it lives outside 03_Application/StoryReader.

compose_only_host_side: STORYREADER_CONTENT_DIR — used only in compose.yml's volume mapping; never read by Python code, which always reads the fixed container path /app/content

route_registration_note: FastAPI path-parameter routes are unambiguous here (no /views/ style static-vs-dynamic collision like StorageTracker's items router) since every dynamic segment is nested under a distinct static prefix (/versions/, /annotations/). No special registration ordering is required.
